hero.sub: Artisanal leather goods inspired by the equestrian world. Every piece is born in the stable, forged in the workshop and lives with you.
manifesto.p1: We believe true luxury doesn't shout: it whispers. It is felt in the texture of slowly tanned leather, in the stitching finished by hand, in the aroma of a stable at dawn.
manifesto.p2: Every bag, every wallet, every accessory is conceived to accompany those who live with purpose —between the city and the countryside, between the timeless and the everyday—.
collection.sub: A curated selection of our most iconic silhouettes.
split.p: A universe where leather breathes, sunlight filters through trees, and each piece finds its place between the everyday and the extraordinary.
craft.p: Each piece undergoes more than forty hand operations. Cutting, beveling, edge dyeing, stitch by stitch. Time is not our enemy: it is our material.
craft.stat_1_caption: Time is the true material of every honest craft.
craft.stat_2_caption: Every piece of leather remembers the hands that shaped it.
craft.stat_3_caption: Nobility cannot be imitated: it is cured with time.
contact.p: Private atelier · Visits by appointment · Bespoke orders.
